content.tagline: Korean premium skincare brand by Brandholder Inc.
content.descriptor: KOY by Brandholder Inc.: Korean premium skincare with protein-based SOLID care, nature-inspired FLOW care and BLOOM glow care
about: KOY is a premium skincare brand of Brandholder Inc., a Korean company. The brand is built around the idea “True Beauty comes from Rest”: according to its official materials, KOY was created to offer a moment of self-care and rest in everyday life.

The range is organised into three lines. SOLID focuses on protein-based firming and nourishing care, FLOW on nature-inspired care for elasticity, soothing, pores and hydration, and BLOOM on radiance, sun care, cleansing and glow makeup.

According to the company’s brand catalogue, KOY is sold in Korea through its official online store, Olive Young stores, Hyundai Department Store and TV home shopping. The brand runs official websites in Korean, English and Japanese. This is the company’s own description; Teranova has not independently verified it.

lines.name: SOLID
lines.note: Protein-infused volume care. According to the company, formulas built on protein complexes for firmness, density and nourishment: cleanser, toner, ampoules, cream, mist, sheet mask, sun cream and cushion.

lines.name: FLOW
lines.note: Care inspired by nature. The company describes four solutions: Lifting for elasticity, Relief for soothing and tone, Soft for pores and texture, and Intensive for hydration.

lines.name: BLOOM
lines.note: Radiance and glow care. According to the company: lotion toner, essence sun cream, deep cleansing oil, cushion, glow stick highlighter and tinted lip balm.

tech.name: Protein complexes
tech.note: According to the company, the SOLID line is built on protein complexes; in the Solid Volume Ampoule, for example, hydrolysed rice protein water replaces purified water.

tech.name: Rest as the brand idea
tech.note: The brand calls its approach “unaging”: beauty that does not fight time, with care framed as moments of rest — Refresh, Recharge, Recovery.

tech.name: Signature products
tech.note: The official website highlights the Solid Volume Ampoule, Flow Lifting Wrapping Cream, Bloom Glow Essence Sun Cream and Solid Platinum Retinolic Lifting Serum.
